Export contours from a Seurat object and run TPCA

Source: R/run_tpca_from_seurat.R
run_tpca_from_seurat.Rd

Accepts the raw segmentation list returned by ReadXenium or ReadNanostring, normalises the contour data frame, passes it directly to kendall_tpca (no intermediate parquet), runs TPCA, and returns a result ready for store_tpca_results().

run_tpca_from_seurat(
  obj,
  seg_list,
  contour_type = c("cell", "nucleus"),
  output_dir = NULL,
  cell_ids = NULL,
  num_vertices = 50L,
  eta = 1,
  use_parallel = FALSE,
  num_threads = 8L,
  frechet_mean_tol = 1e-04,
  max_frechet_iter = 1000L,
  return_results = TRUE,
  store_history = FALSE
)

Arguments

obj

A Seurat object. Used to optionally subset contours to cells present in the object.

seg_list

The list returned by ReadXenium or ReadNanostring.

contour_type

One of "cell" or "nucleus".

output_dir

Directory for TPCA intermediate outputs. Optional. If NULL (the default), a temporary directory is used. When return_results = TRUE the temp directory is deleted after the call; when return_results = FALSE it is kept so saved files remain accessible. An explicit path is created if absent and always left on disk.

cell_ids

Optional character vector of cell IDs to analyse. Defaults to all cells in obj.

num_vertices

Integer. Vertices to sample per contour (default 50).

eta

Numeric. TPCA eta parameter (default 1).

use_parallel

Logical. Use parallel processing (default FALSE).

num_threads

Integer. Threads when use_parallel = TRUE.

frechet_mean_tol

Numeric. Convergence tolerance for Frechet mean.

max_frechet_iter

Integer. Maximum Frechet mean iterations.

return_results

Logical. If TRUE (default), results are loaded into R and returned. If FALSE, results are written to disk and only the output path is returned, with a message showing how to load them via load_kstitch_results.

store_history

Logical. If TRUE, the Fréchet mean iteration history is attached to the returned result as attr(result, "frechet_history"), a named list with $grad_norm (numeric vector) and $mu_history (array). Only meaningful when return_results = TRUE. Default FALSE.

Value

When return_results = TRUE: a named list with element "all" containing TPCA_Embedding, Info, Metadata, contour_type, group, and is_groupwise. When return_results = FALSE: a list with output_path (character scalar) giving the directory written by load_kstitch_results(..., type = "tpca").

See also

load_kstitch_results, store_tpca_results
